verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official CLI that manages flags, segments, features, organisations, projects and environments from the terminal. It also supports SDK-style flag evaluation, raw API access and a shareable defaults file, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: explicit agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured/JSON output or non-interactive auth for AI agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
The file does not bear any sensitive information and is safe to check in to your repository so your teammates' CLIs pick up your defaults.
